summary: Contestants create a complete business plan for a student-run service business, including a research paper and a presentation. The plan must address business description, customer demographics, marketing, pricing, financials, challenges, and solutions. Both the paper and presentation are judged for content, organization, and communication skills.
time_limits: No more than three (3) minutes for setup
No more than ten (10) minutes for the presentation
No more than five (5) minutes for judges’ questions
Presentation will be stopped at ten (10) minutes
submission_requirements: Research paper must not exceed five (5) pages, double-spaced, single-sided numbered pages with one-inch margins (excluding the Title Page and Works Cited)
Research paper must follow the Report format in the Style & Reference Manual
Each research paper must include a Title Page and Works Cited which follow the Style & Reference Manual format
Any research paper submitted beyond the maximum number of pages will be disqualified
Materials must follow the organization’s BPA Graphic Standards and make proper use of the BPA logo and/or organization’s name
Team ID is required for all submissions
The team is responsible for securing a signed BPA Release Form(s) from any person, including themselves, whose image or work is used in the project
The team is responsible for citing all sources, including themselves, on the Works Cited page for any work used on the project
Contestants will be disqualified for violations of the guidelines
deadlines: Submit the URL to https://upload.bpa.org no later than 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on April 1, 2027
what_to_bring: One single-sided laptop, notebook, or tablet for their presentation
competencies: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of entrepreneurship
Create a plan of action to solve the problem presented
Demonstrate effective written and oral communication skills
Identify and utilize internal and external resources
Demonstrate effective persuasive and informative communication and presentation skills

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines and Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy.
Contestant submitted the Research Paper and Works Cited, formatted according to the Style & Reference Manual, and the required BPA Release Form(s) and AI Usage and Documentation Form.

rubric.description: Engaging and insightful introduction; sets a strong foundation for the paper.
Thorough and well-analyzed production information; includes visuals or data where appropriate.
Deep understanding of customer segments; includes analysis and implications.
Creative and strategic marketing approach; includes rationale and potential impact.
Comprehensive financial analysis; includes projections, break-even analysis, and justification.
Strong, reflective conclusion; reinforces main ideas and suggests future directions.
Professionally presented; highly readable, polished, and thorough.

rubric.criterion: Contestant followed the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines.

rubric.description: Contestant maintains good eye contact, uses appropriate gestures and body language, and varies their tone and pace adequately.
The presentation content flows adequately, and the contestant demonstrates a clear and well-integrated structure throughout.
Presentation demonstrates a good understanding of the topic and includes relevant and accurate information.
Responses are detailed, insightful, and effectively address the judges’ questions.

judging_notes: AI Policy Level 2 Permitted with Citation
Carry-in and setup of equipment must be done solely by the team and must take place within the time allotted
No Internet access will be provided on-site at NLC; however, teams may provide their own access to be used only for their presentation to the judges
Finals may be part of the competition
Each state is allowed three (3) entries
Judges’ comments will be returned digitally through the online judging system at the national level
Materials submitted for technical judging will not be returned and will not be available at NLC
Props and/or additional items shall not be used as a basis for scoring
eligibility_notes: Any middle level contestant may enter this event
Contestants must be registered for the national competition before the submission deadline and compete in both parts of the event to be ranked
Entries that do not follow the provided topic, the Copyright and/or Fair Use Guidelines or Artificial Intelligence Usage & Citation Policy will be disqualified
